question: In an unused independent flower-colour radiation, does continuous floral pigment quantity map most strongly to an intermediate-resolution output-control molecular target family?

calibration_context_only.IOCHROMINAE: continuous pigment intensity mapped to a late-pathway coexpression module
calibration_context_only.PETUNIEAE: frozen raw total anthocyanin amount failed to identify a stable primary subspace; source-method log sensitivity favored LATE_OUTPUT but cannot count as primary support

primary_prediction.interpretation: Quantity is predicted to associate with flux/output-control architecture at an intermediate molecular resolution rather than with one exact gene or a complete programme.

candidate_search.stop_rule: After screening at most 20 source publications, admit the deterministic top-ranked passing source or record NO_QUALIFIED_UNUSED_RADIATION without weakening thresholds.

classification_rule.PASS: Coverage passes; best non-null model is LATE_OUTPUT or PATHWAY_REGULATION; best model improves on NULL by >=2 AICc; and best OUTPUT_CONTROL model beats the best non-output model by >=2 AICc.
classification_rule.MIXED: Coverage passes but OUTPUT_CONTROL versus non-output or versus NULL has <2 AICc separation, including ties between target families.
classification_rule.FAIL: Coverage passes and EARLY_CORE or BRANCH_COMPOSITION beats the best OUTPUT_CONTROL model by >=2 AICc, or NULL beats every molecular model by >=2 AICc.
classification_rule.UNQUALIFIED: Any frozen admission requirement fails; no biological negative is inferred.

no_rescue_rule: Do not change the pigment response definition after seeing target-class fits.
Do not merge or split target classes after seeing target-class fits.
Do not change the minimum taxon threshold after candidate screening begins.
Do not promote the predeclared rank sensitivity into the primary classification.
Do not substitute a discrete pigment-loss dataset for continuous pigment quantity.

relationship_to_current_programme.hue_composition_status: descriptively concentrated on branch-control architecture across five heterogeneous systems; not the next highest-information test
relationship_to_current_programme.continuous_quantity_status: two direct radiation-scale systems only; highest-information unresolved phenotype dimension
